text:
tara: Heads-up: planning a rapid staged enable for model `zephyr-mini` tomorrow 11:00 PDT. Goal: keep it reversible with a single operator pin.

maya: Proposed rollout: regional canary order = us-west1 -> eu-west1. 10m @ 4% -> check metrics -> 30m @ 12% -> evaluate 1h -> full. Keep safety-leash on.

ivan: Fallback ordering request: strict order [zephyr-alt-quant, legacy-slim, emergency-degen]. Important: no probabilistic fallback, we need deterministic tail behavior.

deploybot: deploybot: preflight OK except telemetry lag ~90s (non-blocking). Recommended autopin thresholds: p95 >= +16% vs baseline over 10m OR error-rate >= 1% over 5m. Autopin emits PENDING event; operator must ACK.

opsbot: opsbot: KV priming recommended during the 10m warmup:
```sh
curl -X POST https://internal-cache/prime -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"zephyr-mini","prompts":12}'
```
This reduces first-token variance. Also set cache TTL=25s for first 45m, then revert.

sam: I'll own emergency-pin/rollback. Runbook (short): 1) `platformctl pin --model=zephyr-stable --scope=global` 2) zero canary weights 3) notify #customer-uptime + onboarded accounts. If deploybot posts autopin PENDING, I will ACK within 2m or trigger immediate pin if severity high.

jen: Release notes stub: change window 11:00-13:00 PDT, owner rollout=@maya, rollback=@sam, expected customer impact: none to low (brief latency blips possible). I'll post final note after QA.

tara: QA to run crash & perf harness at 10:20. maya, can you confirm?

maya: Confirmed 10:20-10:40 QA. Will paste pass/fail here.

tara: Approved to proceed if no objections to fallback order or thresholds in 40m. :thumbsup:
